knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure says to store products upright, secured, labelled and separated by compatibility, and to follow the SDS and site spill plan.
The worked scenario keeps people clear, reports the leak and does not pour the liquid down a drain. The lesson says not to improvise absorbents.
The core procedure says to store products upright, secured and in original or approved labelled containers, separated according to compatibility instructions.

practicalCriteria: Recognises segregation, secondary containment and limits of personal spill-response authority.
Explains applicable scope and site procedures
Demonstrates hazard controls and safe stop-work decisions
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 5: Keep people clear, and do not enter an atmosphere you cannot identify.
Record of procedure step 7: Report the spill, and escalate anything beyond your training and equipment to the supervisor.
Record of procedure step 8: Record the spill, the escalation and who was told.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Keep people clear, and do not enter an atmosphere you cannot identify.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Do not improvise absorbents, and do not pour liquid down a drain.
Stop work if procedure step 7 is not done: Report the spill, and escalate anything beyond your training and equipment to the supervisor.
